services.desc: Contact Improvisation is a social dance that emerged in the 60’s based on finding improvised ways to dance solo, in duets, and with a group. It is a very relaxing and yet physical method that uses intuition, reflexes, and spontaneous fun in a safe and respectful environment. We will be using a guided, structured warmup exercises, followed by time to practice and improvise (jam), and dancers work at their own level. Garuda combines the core work of Pilates, with the postures of yoga and the fluidity of dance into a full mind and body exercise for both dancers and non-dancers alike.
